Hi Anjali / Rajiv —

Thanks for the heads up about the exec calendar constraints. We can absolutely accommodate an evening slot to make sure your VP + CIO can attend. A couple of options to keep the session tight and low-risk:

- Primary: Apr 4, 17:30 PT — 40 minute live demo with 10-minute executive Q&A (we’ll start with a 5 minute context slide for execs).
- Fallback (short notice): Apr 5, 08:00 PT — same format, in case the evening gets moved.

We’ll record the session end-to-end and provide a 2–3 minute highlight clip for stakeholders who can’t join. We also recommend a 30-minute dry-run earlier the same day for ops/demos: Apr 4, 15:00 PT — to validate VPN/data routing and the VIP scenario you outlined (multi-tenant isolation + private VPC example).

Attached: a short runbook and our updated MAP deck so your execs have context.

If Apr 4 evening works, I’ll send the calendar invite and a dry-run invite to your technical lead + our SEs. Also happy to loop procurement if you want credit/pilot paperwork ready before the demo.

Thanks —
Olga

We’ll have Rajiv join the dry-run at 15:00 PT and I’ll loop procurement if we need to fast-track the pilot paperwork after the demo.
